name: experience-layer-phase-3-story-recall
title: Experience Layer Phase 3 (final): Story Recall via structured-field similarity over the existing story_list scan — no FTS, no derived index, read-only
description: Implement the final Experience Layer slice (Phase 3 / Level 2) from docs/requirements/decisions/lattice-experience-layer-execution-plan.md: a core/story-recall.ts that builds lightweight structured profiles from existing story metadata and scores similarity by structured-field overlap, plus a read-only recall CLI (recall --story <id> / --query). It reuses the existing story_list filesystem scan as the source — NO full-text search, NO derived story-index, NO embedding (the plan's cut-FTS decision). Recall writes nothing and never touches a gate; the recall module keeps zero outward coupling except the story read port. Proven by a smoke covering profile building, similarity ranking + top-N, story_list reuse (no derived index created), read-only behaviour, and no regression. Phase 4 (cross-project aggregation) is future and out of scope.
